content.text: The Houston Astros and Seattle Mariners face off on Sunday in MLB action. T-Mobile Park is set to host the exciting weekend matchup between the Houston Astros and the Seattle Mariners on Sunday in MLB regular-season action. The two teams opened the series with a thrilling 15-run meeting on Friday night in Seattle. The hosts were able to come away with the 9-6 victory thanks to runs from the entire starting lineup spread out over the bottom of the first, fifth and seventh innings. J.P. Crawford, Cal Raleigh and Julio Rodríguez all scored in the first. Then, Randy Arozarena homered on a fly ball to left-center field in the fifth to bring home Josh Naylor. Finally, Luke Raley, Cole Young, Dominic Canzone and Leo Rivas all scored in the bottom of the seventh.
